title: Food Delivery Man Riding Bicycle, 1950s Japan B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing a traditional Japanese food delivery worker (demae) balancing stacked wooden trays on his shoulder while riding a utility bicycle down a narrow, foliage-lined residential lane. The man wears a light white t-shirt, a cloth cap, and trousers rolled up above the ankles. This practice of delivering meals like soba or ramen by bicycle with acrobatic balance on one shoulder was a common sight in Mid-20th-century urban and suburban Japan.
